content.text: Digital creators often face significant obstacles when trying to set up online stores, especially in regions where platforms like Stripe are unavailable. This guide focuses on using Supabase as your order database, allowing you to create a fully operational digital store without relying on conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-19|payment]] processors. We’ll walk you through the setup process using COREMERCH's Sovereign Blueprint, ensuring that your store is up and running efficiently, even if you're in a country like Zimbabwe or Nigeria, where financial [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-internationally-honest-side-3|COREMERCH guide to kenyan]]-creators-get-paid-5|The Full]] is lacking.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many digital creators in developing regions encounter barriers due to platform restrictions and financial isolation. COREMERCH's infrastructure bypasses these limitations by utilizing open-source technologies and decentralized payment systems, ensuring that you retain control over your store. The combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions establishes a robust framework that doesn't rely on conventional financial systems. This means that, even in environments where traditional payment processors fail, your digital store can operate smoothly and efficiently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the essential components to ensure a seamless setup. First, create a GitHub account if you don't already have one, as this will be your primary hosting platform. Next, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be used for your backend processing. You also need to set up a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions; it offers over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Finally, prepare your digital products—like ebooks or courses—ready for upload, ensuring they are formatted correctly for delivery.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying Stack 01, which involves utilizing GitHub Pages and Apps Script. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for step-by-step guidance, typically taking 4-6 hours for setup. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments, linking it to your store. Implement the delivery mechanism, ensuring that your digital products can be automatically sent to customers upon payment confirmation. This setup allows you to process transactions securely and deliver products immediately, enhancing customer satisfaction.
You own everything after deployment—no third-party access.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store setup is complete, it's time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site and ensure that your Apps Script backend is functioning correctly. Test your payment process using NOWPayments on the mainnet with small transactions to verify everything works as expected. Once confirmed, you can officially launch your store, promoting it to your audience. Be prepared to support your customers as they make their first transactions, ensuring a smooth experience that builds trust and credibility in your brand.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and operating smoothly, consider strategies for scaling. You can expand your product offerings by adding more digital products to your store. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features, such as integrating with Supabase for order management, which can enhance your store's capabilities. Monitor customer feedback and transaction volumes to identify areas for improvement. As you grow, ensure your infrastructure can adapt to increased traffic and sales, maintaining performance and reliability.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for transaction processing. You can follow the structured guidance provided in the Sovereign Blueprint to set up your store efficiently. This method eliminates the need for conventional payment processors like Stripe, ensuring seamless operations in regions where they're unavailable.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting your store. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend configuration. Set up a NOWPayments account to manage crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products for upload to the store. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint to deploy Stack 01 within 4-6 hours. Test the payment processing to ensure functionality before going live. Promote your store to attract customers and begin processing transactions.
